voice_lines.name: intro
voice_lines.text: These were real plans. Drawn by real architects. Some were even started. None of them were ever finished. Here are six buildings the world almost built.

voice_lines.name: n6
voice_lines.text: Number six. A monument for Isaac Newton.

voice_lines.name: n5
voice_lines.text: Number five. A tower with rooms that spin.

voice_lines.name: n4
voice_lines.text: Number four. London's answer to the Eiffel Tower.

voice_lines.name: n3
voice_lines.text: Number three. A city inside a pyramid.

voice_lines.name: n2
voice_lines.text: Number two. The plan to lower the Mediterranean Sea.

voice_lines.name: n1
voice_lines.text: And number one. A skyscraper one mile high.

voice_lines.name: outro
voice_lines.text: Six futures that stayed on paper. Which one do you wish had been built? Tell me in the comments.
